content.body: The M1 Garand is best known for two things: its semi-automatic firing and the hallmark "ping" sound when its 8-round en bloc clip was ejected. The semi-automatic fire gave it a tremendous advantage over opponents using the bolt-action rifles that had been the previous standard. General George S. Patton called it "the greatest implement of battle ever devised."
content.brief: TIPO: M1 Garand Rifle CALIBRE: .30-06 cal (7.62 mm) CAPACIDAD DEL CARGADOR: 8 rounds in en bloc clip VELOCIDAD DE SALIDA: 800 m/s CADENCIA DE DISPARO: Semi-automatic ARMAS INCLUÍDAS: 4 x Granadas HE No.36M 2 x Granadas de Humo No.77 MK II 1 x Canana de suministro de munición 1 x Cuchillo de Combate
content.title: Semi-Auto Rifleman
